column1: # Golden vectors for borealis_launch_fps. Format: see tests/fixtures/README.md.
# is_gfe is 1 for a GFE host, 0 for any other host. expected is the fps of the /launch mode parameter.
# GFE keeps the upstream rule: above 60 becomes 0, the stream fps is ignored.
# Other hosts get the RTSP maxFPS so /launch and RTSP agree.
# Non-positive stream fps falls back to the upstream rule.
# Non-positive launch fps yields 0 (host default) whenever it is the value used.
